comment.text: TRAF7 N520 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Bowel tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: peritoneum; Soft tissue tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: softtissue. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.
